title: apricity lab: one agent-friendly front door for the music tools
description:
User (2026-09-27): "fold those new tools into elegant subcommands or whatever to make an agent's life easier."

Today an agent must, by hand:
- build a current binary;
- link the sample audio into its worktree;
- render a window with --stems and run apricity check and steer;
- apply ops through Python and re-render;
- delete the stems and convert to m4a;
- publish or pull listening cycles.

That's about 10 scripts with inconsistent flags: scripts/optimize.py, explore.py, audition-form.py, cycle.py, harmony-backtest.py, fit-features.py and check-stems.py, plus the skill's clap-neighbors.py, audition.sh, swap-audition.py, palette.py and ratings.py.

Design: one entry point, scripts/lab. It's thin Python: it calls the Rust CLI for render, check and steer, and the existing modules for the rest.
- Consistent subcommands, and --json on all of them.
- A shared context that finds the binary (preferring target/release, otherwise building it with a clear message) and links the score's sample audio automatically.
- Every render goes to a managed temp dir and is deleted afterwards; only .m4a and .json are kept, unless --keep.

    lab measure SCORE [--bars A-B]                  render the window, check and steer; print objective_v2, the heard chords and the top suggestions
    lab try SCORE --op JSON | --suggestion N        apply an op or a steer suggestion to a copy, measure before and after, keep it only if better (--min-gain 2)
    lab audition SCORE --layer TRACK [--window A-B] the 16-bar audition .m4a (+ Δwindow)
    lab neighbors --ref 'SAMPLE CLIP' [--prompt T]  the CLAP shortlist
    lab swap SCORE --role TRACK (--candidates F | --neighbors)   the explorer
    lab add SCORE [--roles ...] [--style T]         the optimizer
    lab cycle publish | list | pull ... [--target local|cloud]   listening cycles (the Listen page)
    lab backtest                                    the harmony backtest
    lab palette | ratings | features

The old scripts become thin wrappers or are removed (no backward compatibility unless a test needs it). Update the write-score skill to use lab everywhere. Tests: the dispatcher, the context, and the measure/try path on a small example score.

comments.text: Merged in PR #47: scripts/lab with measure, try, audition, neighbors, swap, add, cycle, backtest, palette, ratings and features; the old scripts are wrappers; the skill teaches lab. Owner config and boto3 handling for cloud publishing move to apricitus-e59a0b.
